function.description: Find real open times — call it whenever the caller names a day, a time, or asks what's available, and again every time their preference changes. Offer ONLY times it returned, at most three, phrased exactly as given. Vague asks ('sometime next week') pick the first plausible date and call it; you can call again for other days. If they asked for a therapist by name, pass the name in providerPreference and trust the tool's verdict on whether that person exists.
function.name: checkAvailability

preferredDate.description: Local date in YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later. Never guess a year the caller did not say.

providerPreference.description: Provider name if the caller asked for someone specific. Leave empty if not.

serviceCode.description: Service code, e.g. massage_60. Call getServicesAndPricing first to get it.

timePreference.description: Rough time of day the caller asked for. Use 'any' if they did not say.
